Let’s join Vietlook Travel to check out the delicious and attractive dishes that you must try once in your life, including dishes such as: Bun cha, broken rice with pork ribs, grilled spring rolls, braised pork belly…

Nem lui

A famous delicious dish in Hue, made from ground pork with minced pork, onions, garlic and wrapped around lemongrass stalks, and seasoned to create eye-catching colors, the spices are often made from fish sauce, oyster sauce, annatto oil, ground pepper, sugar or honey and grilled on a charcoal stove to bring out the delicious flavor of Central Vietnam cuisine.

Nem lui is often served with raw vegetables wrapped in rice paper, with a sauce made from ground sticky rice, stir-fried minced meat, crushed peanuts, sweet fish sauce, satay… mixed together to bring an irresistible delicious flavor, if you have the opportunity to travel to Hue, you should enjoy nem lui to feel the delicious flavor that this place has brought to visitors.

Bun Cha

When talking about Bun Cha, people immediately think of Hanoi. This is a dish that many tourists choose when traveling to Hanoi, especially foreign tourists. Bun is eaten with minced meat and sweet crab broth, along with lettuce, cucumber, chili, pepper, lemon… bringing a delicious flavor.

Broken rice with pork ribs

This is one of the quite famous dishes – broken rice is cooked into rice and served with grilled pork ribs, grilled pork, fried eggs, egg rolls, shredded pork skin… with chopped onions, tomatoes, cucumbers and pickled vegetables.

Eat with garlic and chili sauce kept separately in a bowl, when eating, pour it on the rice according to the taste of each diner, it will bring a delicious flavor, although the dish is available in every region, the best is still Saigon broken rice.

So to enjoy the delicious flavors, let’s travel across Vietnam with Vietlook Travel, to feel and enjoy the delicious dishes with the bold flavors of the Vietnamese countryside.
